description: Loads one list that a person uploaded to the Lists folder of Order Desk's files: products, customers, delivery addresses or the customer catalogue. It tells which list it is from the column names. Existing rows are updated, new ones are added, nothing is deleted. Upload the file again whenever the list changes. Uses no AI.
